name: Stratham Summer Rec Camp
description_short: Town run day camp at Stratham Memorial School for Stratham children entering grades 1 to 6, weekdays 8:30 to 3:00 for five weeks. Campers rotate through activities at the school, take a Thursday bus trip to Wallis Sands Beach and walk to Stratham Hill Park on most Fridays.
refund_policy_summary: A $25 fee per camper applies to changes or cancellations made by May 15; no refunds after May 15.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 camp for Stratham residents only, July 6 to August 7, 8:30 to 3:00, registration by grade entered in fall 2026 (rising 1st to 6th), 20 campers per grade a week; weekly dates are the Monday to Friday weeks in that range

Researched by Claude from this page; 2026 Family Handbook: held at Stratham Memorial School; Thursday bus to Wallis Sands Beach; Friday walking trips to Stratham Hill Park; lunch from home; ages derived from grades 1 to 6 (age_min = grade_min + 5, age_max = grade_max + 6)

warnings: No 2026 price is on the town page or in the family handbook.
The town page gives the season (July 6 to August 7) but not a list of weeks; the five Monday to Friday weeks are read from that range.
The same page lists separate mountain bike, Lego robotics and basketball camps, which are not part of this listing.
